title: Cute But Not Made Well
text: Cute But Not Made Well. I love decorating my home for Halloween. I thought this would look nice on the front door. It's cute, but not made very well. Mainly, it's the glue job that looks bad. There are large globs of dried glue around the edges that holds the lights in place. They look very messy. As someone who likes to make crafts, I would not be satisfied with something that looked like this. I'm very particular with my crafting. The picture in the description does show the glue, so I wasn't completely surprised. Rope is included and you have to attach it yourself. It does come with batteries, which is a plus. Overall, it's okay, but not outstanding.
